column1: # mirror-nonlatin-wiki.py (#525). Not part of the fetch/verify contract --
# manifest.tsv's url/sha256/bytes columns are what fetch.sh reads. This file
# exists solely to carry CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution forward once manifest.tsv's
# own url column stops pointing at the source article: each row here names
# the hosted file (by its manifest `path`) and the Wikipedia article and
# licence it came from. See README.md, 'Licences and attribution'.
